title: Multi-step cancel with a payment that can fail halfway
measures: Plans the failure cases of a refund-and-restock operation: a declined refund leaves stock alone, a second cancel does nothing, and a retry after a timeout uses PayGate's idempotency key instead of refunding again.
prompt: Add cancelOrder(id) to src/ordering.js: it refunds the customer through PayGate, puts the items back in stock and marks the order cancelled.

commits.message: feat: orders, invoices, shipping and catalog modules
feat(ordering): place orders with stock and PayGate
